capabilities: Sync vault notes to a Neo4j database
Render a graph view with nodes styled by tags, folders and link types
Run Cypher queries from cypher code blocks
Create typed links with - linkType [[note]] syntax
Open the vault in Neo4j desktop apps like Bloom, GraphXR and Browser
extras: The README states the plugin will be removed from the community plugins soon; the successor Juggl no longer requires Neo4j or Python. Syncing changes to Neo4j is described as 'still very buggy'.
intentEvidence: Adds a new and much more functional graph view to Obsidian
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view offers limited styling, filtering, and no way to query the vault as a graph database.

relations.evidence: This plugin has been rewritten with new name Juggl
It does so by connecting to a Neo4j database
uses the Python package semantic-markdown-converter, which is also in this repo

requires.name: Neo4j desktop with a running database

summary: Graph visualization plugin that syncs the vault into a Neo4j database for a styled, queryable graph with Cypher and typed links.
